div.head: IV Eg 8.1
div.ab: Gif he swa ne deð ær fif nihtum, cyðan hit þæs tunes men þam hundrodes ealdre, ⁊ beon buton wite ægðer ge hy sylfe ge heora hyrdas; ⁊ ðolige þæs ofres ðe hit þider brohte, for ði þe he hit his neahgeburum cyðan nolde, ⁊ fó se landrica to healfon ⁊ to healfan þæt hundred.

If he does not so so within five days, the villagers shall inform the head of the hundred, and neither they or their herdsmen shall be fined; and he who brought the livestock there shall forfeit it, because he has failed to give notice of it to his neighbours, and the lord of the manor shall take half and the hundred half.

Gif he swa ne deð ǽr fíf nihtum, cyðan hit þæs tunes men þam hundrodes ealdre, ⁊ beon buton wite ægðer ge hy sylfe ge heora hyrdas; ⁊ þolige þæs orfes þe hit þider brohte, for þy þe he hit his neahgeburum cyðan nolde; ⁊ fó se landrica to healfon ⁊ to healfan þæt hundred.
